description: (Re)run asynchronous audio processing on an existing post. Processing state is storage-layer and outside the record CID, so this changes no content address — which is why re-running enrichment is a procedure of its own rather than an edit.

main.description: Requests processing stages for a post's audio and returns the re-hydrated view. Author-only. No lexicon field is editable here: those feed the record CID, so changing one would mint a different record rather than update this one.

id.description: Record key of the post to process.

processing.description: The stages to run. A request enabling no stage is rejected rather than treated as a no-op.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: No processing stage was enabled, or the post has no audio to process.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The acting actor is not the post's author.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No post with this key in the caller's tenancy.
